reason: Choreo is a Parthenon Capital-backed RIA with ~$25B AUM, ~183-200 employees and 50 offices that BUYS wealth-tech (eMoney et al.) rather than owning a revenue-critical legacy data platform — wrong side of the market for Shawn's SQL Server/.NET modernization niche; it already has a full-time CIO (the Senior Director, IT/InfoSec role explicitly 'reports to the Head of Technology (CIO)'), a 5-person Platform & Technology team, a PMO and a 'hybrid IT operating model that includes internal resources and third-party service providers,' so the posting signals a staffed department adding a management layer, not bus-factor-1 with no technical leadership, and the firm is far too large for a fractional CTO engagement.

company.name: Choreo, LLC
company.one_liner: Chicago-based PE-backed registered investment advisor (RIA) serving CPA-referred high-net-worth clients; formerly RSM US Wealth Management, lifted out by Parthenon Capital in Feb 2022 and a serial acquirer of CPA-affiliated wealth practices.

drop_reasons: wrong side of market: buyer of wealth-tech, not a data-heavy B2B SaaS vendor with its own legacy platform
technical leadership already in place: CIO / Head of Technology, Platform & Technology team, PMO, M&A integration function
too large for a fractional CTO engagement: PE-backed, ~$25B AUM, 50 offices, enterprise IT/security director hire
no evidence of a bus-factor-1 SQL Server/SSIS legacy platform with calendar-fixed contracted deliverables (the EDP)
